description: A reference snippet for a language and framework you name: returns the install command, the canonical code to record an agent's tool calls with signafAIde, and the verify command. It reads nothing in the project, detects nothing, changes nothing and sends nothing; the same arguments always give the same answer. Use it to answer a question about a stack that is not the open project, or when signafaide_setup could not tell the language. When you are working inside a project, use signafaide_setup instead: it detects the stack and previews the exact edit for that project.
name: signafaide_quickstart
title: signafAIde snippet for a language and framework
